name: Flaim Fantasy
description: Flaim is a read-only fantasy analysis service working with ESPN, Yahoo, and Sleeper league platforms. It unifies league and season context, then returns structured standings, roster, matchup, free-agent, and transaction information so users can evaluate decisions quickly. Flaim is retrieval-only and cannot perform league changes such as trades or add/drop actions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Flaim Fantasy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Flaim Fantasy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.flaim.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Flaim Fantasy MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flaim Fantasy provides these MCP tools: get_user_session, get_ancient_history, get_league_info, get_standings, get_matchups, get_roster, get_free_agents, get_players, and get_transactions.

_published_faq.name: Does Flaim Fantasy MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flaim Fantasy requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Flaim Fantasy is developed by Flaim. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
